## Introduction

In this assignment, we explore the Seoul Bike Sharing dataset
and develop multiple linear regression models to predict
daily bicycle rentals.

We begin by importing and exploring the data, then prepare
the data for modeling, fit three regression models, and
compare their predictive performance using RMSE.

## Reading in the Data

```{r}
# Load the packages needed for data manipulation and exploration
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(rsample)

# Read the locally saved Seoul Bike Sharing dataset
# Specify Latin1 encoding to handle special characters
bike_data <- read_csv(
  "data/SeoulBikeData.csv",
  locale = locale(encoding = "Latin1")
)

# Examine the structure of the dataset
glimpse(bike_data)
```
